data: Apple delivered modest top-line expansion in fiscal 2024, with revenue rising 2.0% to $391.0 billion from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Profitability at the operating level was stronger: gross profit climbed to $180.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $169.1 billion in fiscal 2023, supporting a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 46.2%, while operating income increased to $123.2 billion from $114.3 billion, yielding a fiscal 2024 operating margin of 31.5%. The company continued to invest, lifting R&D expense to $31.4 billion in fiscal 2024 from $29.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Below the operating line, however, results softened. Net income fell 3.4% to $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted EPS slipped to $6.08 from $6.13. Operating strength was not fully reflected in earnings for fiscal 2024.
